title: The One Ring
gametext:
While wearing The One Ring, each time bearer is about to take a wound, add a burden instead.
Maneuver: Wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.
Skirmish: Add a burden to make the Ring-bearer strength +3.
subtitle: The Great Ring

title: Gimli
gametext:
Fellowship. Damage +1.
Each time you play a [dwarven] possession, you may draw a card.
lore: If anyone was to ask for my opinion, which I note they're not, I'd say we were taking the long way round.
subtitle: Opinionated Guide

title: Still Twitching
gametext:
Bearer must be a [dwarven] companion.
Bearer gains hunter 2. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [dwarven] companion.
At the end of each turn, if bearer did not win a skirmish this turn, discard this condition from play.

title: That's Two!
gametext: Spot Gimli and exert a fellowship companion to have each Shadow player discard one of his or her Shadow cards from play.
lore: Legolas, two already!

title: Army Long Trained
gametext:
Bearer must be an [elven] companion.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [elven] companion.
At the start of the archery phase, you must exert bearer or return this condition to hand.

title: Arwen
gametext:
Ranger.
While you can spot 2 [elven] followers, each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -2.
Maneuver: Add 3 threats to reconcile your hand.
lore: I would rather share one lifetime with you than face all the ages of this world alone.
subtitle: Royal Maiden

title: Legolas
gametext:
Fellowship. Archer.
Archery: Add two threats to wound a minion; Legolas does not add to the fellowship archery total.
lore: Have you heard nothing Lord Elrond has said? The Ring must be destroyed!
subtitle: Skeptical Guide

title: Gandalf
gametext:
Fellowship.
Response: If an event is played, exert Gandalf twice to cancel that event.
lore: The Ring yearns above all else to return to the hand of its master. They are one, the Ring and the Dark Lord. Frodo, he must never find it.
subtitle: Wise Guide

title: Stern Words
gametext:
To play, spot a [gandalf] Wizard.
Bearer must be a companion.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another companion.
At the end of each turn, return this condition to hand.

title: Gollum
gametext:
Gollum is strength +1 for each threat you can spot.
Each time Gollum wins a skirmish, you may add a threat.
lore: 'But if we was master, then we could help ourselfs, yes....'
subtitle: Threatening Guide

title: Sméagol
gametext:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
Each time Sméagol wins a skirmish, you may shuffle up to 2 [gollum] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck.
Skirmish: Exert a Ring-bound companion to make Sméagol strength +2.
lore: ...now that I see him, I do pity him.
subtitle: Pitiable Guide

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Fellowship. Ranger.
While the Ring-bearer is the only other companion you can spot, Aragorn is an archer, defender +1, and can take no more than 1 wound each skirmish.
lore: The skill of the Elves can reforge the sword of Kings, but only you have the power to wield it.
subtitle: Well-traveled Guide

title: Boromir
gametext:
Fellowship. Ranger.
While you can spot two unbound Hobbits, Boromir's twilight cost is -1.
Each time Boromir wins a skirmish, you may exert an unbound Hobbit to discard each minion he is skirmishing from play.
lore: In a dream, I saw the eastern sky grow dark.
subtitle: Destined Guide

title: Not Bound to His Fate
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [gondor] Man.
At the end of each turn, if bearer is not Aragorn, return this condition to hand.
lore: Your time will come. You will face the same evil....

title: Strength in My Blood
gametext:
Bearer must be a fellowship companion.
While bearer is a [gondor] companion, he or she is damage +1.
lore: I would have followed you my Brother... my Captain... my King!

title: Gríma
gametext:
When you play Gríma, you may remove (4) to exert an unbound companion. That companion cannot use special abilities until the regroup phase.
Assignment: Exert Gríma to assign him to an unbound companion. That companion may exert to prevent this.

effect.preventText: Would you like to exert {chosenCompanion} to prevent {self} assigning to it?

subtitle: Servant of Another Master

title: Urgency
gametext:
Weather.
Each time the fellowship moves, add (2) for each Ent you can spot.
Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make a non-[wraith] minion strength +1.
lore: If the mountain defeats you, will you risk a more dangerous road?

title: The Balrog
gametext:
Damage +2. Fierce.
While at an underground site, skip the archery phase, the maneuver phase, and The Balrog cannot be assigned to skirmish companions of strength 6 or less.
lore: The flames roared up to greet it, and wreathed about it....
subtitle: Demon of Might

title: Reaching Tentacle
gametext:
Tentacle.
This minion cannot bear possessions.
Discard this minion from play if not at a marsh.
This minion is strength +1 for each tentacle you can spot.
lore: Frodo felt something seize him by the ankle....

title: Strong Tentacle
gametext:
Tentacle.
This minion cannot bear possessions.
Discard this minion from play if not at a marsh.
This minion is strength +1 for each tentacle you can spot.
lore: One came wriggling over the threshold....

title: Watcher in the Water
gametext:
Discard all other minions (except tentacles).
Watcher in the Water cannot bear possessions.
The fellowship's current site gains marsh.
Shadow: Play a tentacle from your discard pile.
lore: ...as if a host of snakes were swimming up....
subtitle: Many-tentacled Creature

title: Pit Troll
gametext:
Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.)
To play, spot an [orc] Orc.
When you play this minion, add 2 threats. The Free Peoples player may exert the Ring-bearer to prevent this.
lore: Black blood. Flat feet. Scaly skin.

effect.text: Would you like to exert the Ring-bearer to prevent adding 2 threats?

title: Troll of the Deep
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] Orc.
Skirmish: Remove a threat to make an [orc] minion strength +2.
lore: Stones to move. Bridges to be rebuilt.
subtitle: Cave Troll

title: Brought Down from Inside
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
At the start of each skirmish you may transfer this condition to a [rohan] Man.
At the end of each turn, if bearer did not win a skirmish this turn, return this condition to hand.
lore: Bring it down! Bring it down! Bring it down!

title: Éomer
gametext:
Valiant.
Éomer is strength +2 for each wound on each minion he is skirmishing.
lore: Now is the hour, Riders of Rohan, oaths you have taken! Now, fulfill them all! To Lord and Land!
subtitle: Éored Captain

title: Éowyn
gametext:
Valiant.
Fellowship: Play a [rohan] companion with a twilight cost of 3 or more; his or her twilight cost is -1.
lore: It's tradition for the women of the court to farewell the men.
subtitle: Lady of the Mark

title: Sauron's Might
gametext: Remove a Free Peoples culture token to add a threat. When you play this event, you may remove (1) to place this on the bottom of your draw deck instead of in your discard pile.
lore: One by one, the free lands of Middle-earth fell to the power of the Ring.

effect.text: Would you like to remove (1) to place {self} on the bottom of your draw deck?

title: Frodo
gametext:
Ring-bearer. Ring-bound. Fellowship.
While you cannot spot 4 threats, Shadow cards cannot discard cards from your hand or from the top of your draw deck.
lore: We're friends of Gandalf the Grey.
subtitle: Little Master

title: Merry
gametext:
Fellowship.
Skirmish: If Merry is not assigned to a skirmish, take 2 [shire] cards from your discard pile and remove them from the game to make a companion strength +2.
lore: 'You can trust us to stick to you through thick and thin – to the bitter end.'
subtitle: Resolute Friend

title: Pippin
gametext:
Fellowship.
Pippin is strength +1 for each tale you can spot.
lore: 'You must go – and therefore we must, too. Merry and I are coming with you.'
subtitle: Steadfast Friend

title: Rabbit Stew
gametext:
Bearer must be a [shire] companion.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to a fellowship companion.
Each time this condition is transferred to a companion, heal that companion.

title: Sam
gametext:
Ring-bound. Fellowship.
While Sam bears The One Ring, he is resistance -4.
While you can spot 3 [shire] companions, Sam is strength +2.
Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer.
subtitle: Loyal Friend

title: Lurtz
gametext:
Archer. Damage +1.
Response: If Lurtz is about to take a wound or be exerted, remove (2) (or exert another Uruk-hai) to prevent that wound or exertion.
lore: The Uruk-hai leader walked into view on the misty hilltop beneath the dark trees. Hungry for blood.
subtitle: Resilient Captain

title: In Twilight
gametext:
Bearer must be a [wraith] minion.
When you play this, you may draw a card.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [wraith] minion.
lore: The Nazgûl's true forms were revealed to him, shining like ghostly Kings.

title: Úlairë Attëa
gametext:
Fierce.
While you can spot 5 twilight tokens in the twilight pool and another [wraith] card, Úlairë Attëa is strength +3.
lore: Those that knew the most power as kings were placed in particular ways for the will of Sauron.
subtitle: Dark Predator

title: Úlairë Enquëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Maneuver: Spot 6 companions and discard a Nazgûl from hand to wound an unbound companion.
lore: The Nine Riders were embodiments of Sauron's will, searching all of Middle-earth for his prize.
subtitle: Dark Threat

title: Úlairë Lemenya
gametext:
Fierce.
Úlairë Lemenya is strength +1 for each [wraith] possession in your discard pile.
lore: 'Do you wish them to find you? They are terrible!'
subtitle: Dark Enemy

title: Úlairë Nertëa
gametext:
Fierce.
When you play Úlairë Nertëa, name a race. The Free Peoples player cannot assign Úlairë Nertëa to skirmish a companion of the named race.
lore: Some accepted Sauron's gift for glory and a notion of great deeds.
subtitle: Dark Horseman

title: Úlairë Toldëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Úlairë Toldëa cannot be assigned to skirmish the same companion in a fierce skirmish that he has already been assigned to this turn.
lore: Open, in the name of Mordor!' said a voice thin and menacing.
subtitle: Dark Shadow

title: The Witch-king
gametext:
Fierce.
Skirmish: Discard a Nazgûl from hand to make The Witch-king strength +1 (or strength +2 if you can spot that discarded Nazgûl).
lore: 'A great king and sorcerer he was of old, and now he wields a deadly fear.'
subtitle: Dark Lord
